items.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
items.summary: GAMEPLAY · Added an option to switch Silent Reload Mode between Hold and Toggle. With toggle enabled, once the silent reload starts you can let go of the reload button. To cancel a silent reload and go back to a fast reload, you can tap the reload button again. · Fixed various cases where the first sound of a reload was audible irrespective if a user requested a silent reload or not.…
